chooser.title: Which gym do you want to open?
chooser.lead: Every gym you work at, on one account. Each opens its own console.
chooser.draftLine: Not set up yet · only setup continues
chooser.moreFailed: We couldn’t load more gyms. Try again.
chooser.note: We open your last choice next time. Switch any time from the top of the sidebar.

empty.title: You don’t work at a gym yet
empty.lead: Register your gym to open its console. Gyms you are invited to will appear here.

notAvailable.heading: Gym not available
notAvailable.title: This gym isn’t available
notAvailable.body: It doesn’t exist, or you don’t work there. Open one of your own gyms instead.

restricted.heading: Not available for your role
restricted.title: Your role doesn’t include this
restricted.body: You work at this gym, but this part of the console isn’t part of your role. Ask the gym owner if you need it.

draft.title: This gym isn’t set up yet
draft.body: Its console opens once setup is complete. Continue where you left off.
draft.bodyStaff: Its console opens once the owner completes setup.

details.title: Gym details
details.failed: We couldn’t load the gym details. The rest of the page is up to date.
details.restricted: Your role doesn’t include the gym details.

access.title: Your access
access.note: Each action is checked by SimpleFit for this gym. No gym role reads anyone’s private training data.

roles.owner: You own this gym: its details, setup and team, and later its members.
roles.manager: You help run this gym: its details, locations, team and members.
roles.coach: You coach at this gym: your classes and their rosters.
roles.front_desk: You run the front desk: check-ins, bookings and members at the desk.

limited.title: Your dashboard
limited.body: The {role} dashboard isn’t available yet. You can open this gym; its tools arrive with their features.

members.title: Members
members.body: Invite members and see who trains here.

attendance.title: Bookings & check-ins
attendance.body: Bookings and check-ins for each class.

intro.title: Welcome to your gym console
intro.body: A short tour of what works today: your checklist, your gym, the menu and the switcher. About a minute.
intro.resumeBody: You started it on {date}. Tour steps aren’t saved, so it starts from the first step here.
intro.resumeBodyUndated: You started it on another device. Tour steps aren’t saved, so it starts from the first step here.
intro.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed.

completed.title: Introduction finished.
completed.body: It won’t open again on any device. Your checklist keeps following what your gym really does.

dismissed.title: Introduction skipped.
dismissed.body: It won’t open again on any device. Skipping didn’t change your checklist or your gym.

unavailable.title: We couldn’t load your introduction and checklist.
unavailable.body: The console works without them. Nothing was changed.

checklist.title: Your gym’s checklist
checklist.readyBody: Gym identity and location are saved.
checklist.moreBody: These open when their features launch. They aren’t missing steps.
checklist.footnote: Finishing or skipping the introduction doesn’t change this list. Each step ticks itself when your gym really does it, on web and mobile.

create_gym.title: Create your gym
create_gym.completed: Name, type and location are saved
create_gym.available: Finish setup to create your gym

add_class.title: Add your first class
add_class.completed: Your first class is on the timetable
add_class.available: Add a class to your timetable
add_class.coming_later: Comes with classes and the timetable

invite_staff.title: Invite your staff
invite_staff.completed: A staff member accepted an invitation

first_check_in.title: Record a first check-in
first_check_in.available: Check a member in at the desk

skip.title: Skip the introduction?
skip.body: It won’t open again on this or any other device. Your checklist stays exactly as it is: skipping completes nothing.
skip.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

finishing.title: Finishing…
finishing.body: Saving that you finished the introduction. Nothing else changes.

finishFailed.title: We couldn’t save that
finishFailed.body: The introduction stays open and nothing changed. Try again, or finish later on any device.

confirm.label: End introduction
confirm.title: End the introduction?
confirm.body: It won’t open again on this or any other device. Your checklist stays exactly as it is: ending completes nothing.

checklist.title: Your opening checklist
checklist.body: One step is done: your gym exists. Classes, staff, members and check-ins show as coming later until they launch. None of them is counted as missing.

gym.title: Your gym and your access
gym.body: Name, type and location come straight from your setup. Your access shows what your role can do at this gym, and only at this gym.

menu.title: Tools arrive in this menu
menu.body: Dashboard works today. Members, timetable, staff and the rest are marked Soon and open when they launch. Nothing behind them is half-built.

switcher.title: One account, every role
switcher.body: You’re the owner of {name}. Switch gyms or open your fighter or coach profile here, with no second sign-in. Each gym keeps its own data and its own introduction.

done.title: You know your way around
done.body: Saved for this gym on every device: the introduction won’t open again. Your checklist keeps following what your gym really does.

roles.front_desk: {count, plural, one {# at the front desk} other {# at the front desk}}

roster.heading: Team
roster.alone: Only you so far. Invite coaches and front desk staff to work here with you.

active.title: No active staff
active.body: Invited people appear here once they accept.

ended.title: No one has left
ended.body: People who leave or are removed from this gym appear here.

person.heading: {name}
person.owner: The owner keeps full access. It changes only when ownership is transferred.
person.noActions: Your role doesn’t include changing this person’s access.

owner.line: Everything at this gym, including its setup and team
owner.detail: Runs the gym: its details, location and setup, and the whole team.

manager.line: The gym’s details and location; invites and manages coaches and front desk
manager.detail: Helps run the gym: its details and location, and invites coaches and front desk and changes their roles.

coach.line: Coaches at this gym; sees the gym and its team
coach.detail: Coaches at this gym. For now: the gym’s console and its team; classes come later.

front_desk.line: Runs the front desk; sees the gym and its team
front_desk.detail: Runs the front desk. For now: the gym’s console and its team; check-ins come later.

reference.heading: Roles at this gym
reference.never: No gym role reads anyone’s private training data. A coach role here is not a coaching relationship with anyone, and a person’s own coach profile stays theirs.

invite.title: Invite to {gym}
invite.lead: We send an invitation to this address. The person joins only after accepting it while signed in with that address.

email.label: Email
email.rejected: This address can’t be invited. It may be one of your own.

role.label: Role
role.invalid: Choose one of the roles shown.

pending.title: Invitation pending
pending.body: An invitation to {email} as {role} is pending until {expires}.
pending.note: Nothing changes at the gym until they accept. You can resend or cancel it from Invitations.

invitations.heading: Invitations
invitations.notice: Invited people can accept once staff invitations open in SimpleFit. An invitation stays pending until it expires, and you can resend it.
invitations.resent: A new invitation to {email} is pending until {expires}.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelInvitation.body: The invitation to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.

roleChange.title: Change {name}’s role
roleChange.lead: {name} is {role} at {gym}. The new role applies from their next action.
roleChange.label: New role

remove.title: Remove {name} from {gym}?
remove.body: {name} loses access to {gym} at once. Their SimpleFit account, their profiles and any other gym they work at are not affected.

leave.title: Leave {gym}?
leave.body: You lose access to {gym} at once. Your SimpleFit account and any other gym you work at are not affected.

problems.limited: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
problems.limitedLater: Too many requests. Try again later.
problems.pendingOtherRole: This address already has a pending invitation for another role. Cancel it first.
problems.alreadyActive: This person already works at this gym.
problems.noResends: No resends left. Cancel it and invite again.
problems.notPending: This invitation isn’t pending any more.
problems.ownerTransfer: The owner’s access changes only when ownership is transferred.
problems.forbidden: Your role doesn’t allow this any more. The page is up to date.
problems.gone: This person or invitation isn’t part of the gym any more. The page is up to date.
problems.unknown: We couldn’t confirm whether it worked. The page shows the latest state; check it before trying again.
problems.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing changed. Try again.
